title: Forest Biometrics Tools (Ormancılık Biyometrisi Araçları)
description:
Browser-based tools for forest inventory and biometrics data, published at forestbiometry.online: Forest Data Checker, Plot & Stand Metrics, Model Evaluation, Diameter Distribution Lab (Weibull, normal, lognormal, gamma, fixed-bound beta, Johnson SB, exponential and log-logistic, optionally generalized gamma and Gumbel; direct fitting, L-moments, quantile matching and minimum distance, measurement thresholds, grouped data, parameter recovery after Poudel and Cao (2013), Parresol (2003) and Fonseca et al. (2009), stand models, model comparison, bootstrap uncertainty and the empirical basal area diameter distribution), Height–Diameter Modelling, Inventory Sampling Planner, Relative Ranking, Stem Section Volume (Huber, Smalian, Newton, Hohenadl), Site Index (dynamic difference equations with user coefficients or coefficients fitted to the user's own data) and Stand Structure & Competition (diameter structure, diversity, density, spatial pattern and competition indices).

Data stay in the user's browser; the server keeps no user data. Every scientific calculation is tested against an independent reference (SciPy, NumPy, mpmath, scikit-learn or hand-computed cases); tests and reference generators are included. Interface in Turkish and English; project documentation in Turkish.

Each tool carries its own version; the release notes list the version of every tool in this release.
